summary: Text and direct-message composers now use compact in-field attachment and mention icons instead of large labeled controls. Clipboard paste remains available through Ctrl/Cmd+V, Shift+Insert, and the text-edit context menu; attachment status, chips, errors and retries remain in the attachment widget.

checks.name: Attachment composer tests
checks.observation: All 9 tests passed. Coverage includes the compact attachment widget without former large labels, file picking/upload, clipboard paste, captured conversation scope, retry, partial success and progress.

checks.name: Pixel 7 visual acceptance
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --no-pub && apksigner verify --print-certs build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk && adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk
checks.observation: Built arm64-v8a release APK (38.3 MB), verified its upload certificate SHA-256 matches the installed release, and updated the Pixel 7 in place without clearing app data. The app resumed the existing text channel. A 1080x2400 screenshot showed + and @ inline with the composer and no large labeled buttons; tapping @ opened the member picker, tapping + opened Android DocumentsUI. No file was selected and no message was sent. The OS still reports versionName 1.0.8/versionCode 2012 because this UI validation rebuild intentionally did not bump or publish a release version.

checks.name: macOS and Windows visual acceptance
checks.observation: Matched screenshots, pointer/keyboard traversal and narrow-window behavior have not yet been captured on either desktop platform.

remaining: Capture matched web/Flutter text and DM composer screenshots on macOS and Windows; verify keyboard/pointer traversal, selected-mention chips and paste access, then complete VoiceOver and NVDA acceptance. Android visual/action acceptance passed; TalkBack acceptance remains open.
